definitions.bundleAcceptanceConcordant: same bundle-accepted boolean; a unit with no candidate counts as not accepted
definitions.bothCandidatesGeneratedConcordant: same accept/reject decision among units where both models generated a candidate (the paper's matched units)
definitions.threeWayOutcomeConcordant: same outcome among no-candidate / rejected / accepted

note: Accept/reject decision concordance between models. It does not by itself explain the within-0.002 per-gate agreement: per-unit SC-VAC differs in some concordant units, and the net shift from discordant units is largely offset by concordant units and by units where only one model generated a candidate.
